findings.description: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and SECURITY.md published reporting addresses on devswitchboard.dev, but the domain did not resolve in DNS.
findings.correction: Removed the two policy files and their README links from the initial publication set; later policy publication requires real configured channels.

findings.description: The configured Git author email is a personal Gmail address that would be recorded permanently in the public initial commit.
findings.correction: Configured the developer-approved GitHub noreply address in repository-local Git configuration only.

findings.description: A contributor-controlled record can select a permissive in-repository schema and make an unapproved Approved Handoff produce verification: PASS.
findings.correction: Bound each recognized record kind to its canonical repository schema and added regressions for in-repository and absolute external schema-selection tricks.

findings.description: A Work State can retain lifecycle_state complete while verification_state is failed and still produce verification: PASS.
findings.correction: Required passed verification for complete lifecycle state in both the Work State schema and the semantic verifier, with an executable failed-verification regression.

findings.description: The GitHub CLI reports an invalid credential for the intended Sonos18 account.
findings.correction: Re-authenticated GitHub CLI and verified the active account as Sonos18 with public account ID 135192485.
